design.affected_system: urban water supply, distribution, and conservation system
alternatives: validate meters in the largest unexplained zones
deploy pressure and acoustic monitoring to persistent anomalies
combine meter correction with targeted leak investigation
assumptions: Supply, demand, leakage, and storage balances use reconciled units and meter coverage.
Restriction response and climate sequences are observed inputs or labeled scenarios.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
design.baseline: Current leakage detection and meter replacement continue.

constraints.description: An anomaly must exceed combined production, customer-meter, and boundary-flow uncertainty.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

design.decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
design.decision_owner: water utility general manager and drought-response lead
design.decision_question: Which zones show persistent production-consumption imbalance after meter uncertainty and authorized uses are reconciled?

independence_key.binding_constraint: An anomaly must exceed combined production, customer-meter, and boundary-flow uncertainty.
independence_key.evidence_gate: Production, transfer, customer meter, authorized-use, and asset-zone records meet declared coverage thresholds.

design.intended_claim: A versioned diagnose design for comparing declared alternatives affecting distribution-zone water balance anomalies, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: distributional gap in unexplained distribution water volume
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not label balance residuals as confirmed leaks or unauthorized consumption.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Production, transfer, customer meter, authorized-use, and asset-zone records meet declared coverage thresholds.

design.title: Diagnose non-revenue water and demand anomalies
transportability_risks: Water rights, source portfolios, pricing, metering, leakage, and climate regimes differ.
Household conservation behavior may not transfer across tariff and tenure systems.

family.affected_system: urban water supply, distribution, and conservation system
claim_boundary: Hazard observations and modeled exposure do not establish individual harm or causation.
Proposed adaptations are planning alternatives, not adopted policy or engineered designs.
A design-only record is not a city execution, validated forecast, or impact result.
family.decision_owner: water utility general manager and drought-response lead
family.description: Decision designs for water loss diagnosis, demand and supply forecasting, renewal and reuse investment, distribution, scheduling, multi-year stress, and conservation evaluation.
family.title: Drought and urban water security

library_claim_boundary: The catalog contains 240 decision designs, not 240 city executions.
Exactly twelve designs map to existing Tier-D reference templates; 228 remain design-only.
A reference implementation can be an explicit negative release and does not imply impact.
No record claims a city binding, new method, deployment, adoption, or real-user outcome.
Future execution requires source binding, gate passage, and domain, legal, community, and operational review.
